name: Verify user confirms resolution via knowledge article - ticket deflection
objective: Validate that when a user confirms their issue is resolved by a knowledge article, no ticket is created and the interaction is logged as a deflection.
precondition: User is logged in, on home page, AI Assistant panel is open. Assistant has provided a knowledge article answer.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon and ask a question that returns a knowledge article
steps.testData: "How do I connect to VPN from home"
steps.expectedResult: AI Assistant provides a knowledge article answer

steps.testData: Click 'Yes, resolved' or say "Yes that answers my question"

steps.expectedResult: No incident number or ticket confirmation is shown

steps.description: Verify the interaction is logged as a ticket deflection
steps.expectedResult: The session is marked as resolved via knowledge (deflection)
